pr_summary: Fix GIF image descriptor initialization in lv_gif.c/h - properly initialize image descriptor headers (magic, flags, color format, width, height, stride, data_size) when loading GIFs to prevent rendering artifacts or crashes. Change imgdsc type from lv_draw_buf_t to lv_image_dsc_t.
patch_file_cues: lv_gif_set_src function modified to properly initialize imgdsc header fields
imgdsc type changed from lv_draw_buf_t to lv_image_dsc_t
test_file_cues: test_bin_decoder.c provides pattern for image decoder tests
No existing GIF-specific test file found - new test may be needed
platform_constraint_evidence: scripts/install-prerequisites.sh installs Linux packages via apt
CMake build system is cross-platform with no platform-specific restrictions for the touched GIF files
No Windows-only (MSVC, WinAPI) or macOS-only (Xcode, Metal) dependencies in the fix area
notes: LVGL is a cross-platform embedded graphics library. The fix modifies GIF object initialization to properly set image descriptor fields. The build uses CMake with optional Ninja generator. Tests are run via Python script main.py. Platform is Linux-compatible with no special platform constraints.
